description: Points a small business domain (apex and www) at the new website we built for it, hosted on Vercel. Only the apex A record(s) and the www CNAME are written; the template has no MX, TXT, SPFM, SRV or NS records, so email and verification records are never touched.
variableDescription: %ip1%: first apex IPv4 address Vercel assigns the project (from Vercel's domain config API); %ip2%: second apex IPv4 address when Vercel assigns two (group apex2, applied only then); %wwwcname%: the project-specific CNAME target Vercel assigns, e.g. 0123456789abcdef.vercel-dns-016.com
